bio.text: Mindy McAlindon is serving her second term in the Arkansas House of Representatives, representing District 10, which includes a portion of Benton County.
Her professional background includes work with Ford Motor Company, Procter & Gamble, Sara Lee and Merck, and she has operated a consulting business for more than 15 years.
She lives in Centerton and is a mother of four.
